name: WordPress Plugin Boilerplate
summary: WordPress plugin boilerplate with a React + shadcn/ui frontend, PHP backend, Laravel-style ORM and Vite HMR.
description: Starter for building WordPress plugins with modern tooling: a React frontend and PHP backend communicating over an API, shadcn/ui components, a Laravel-familiar Eloquent ORM for WordPress, Vite dev server with HMR, SASS/Tailwind, Storybook, Gutenberg blocks, shortcodes, plugin renaming and a PlugKit CLI scaffolder.
contains: WordPress plugin boilerplate with React frontend and PHP backend
Laravel-style Eloquent ORM with models, migrations and seeders
Vite + HMR dev server; Grunt build; Storybook
API routes, shortcodes, Gutenberg blocks, marketing site and docs
plugin renaming via plugin-config.json; PlugKit CLI scaffolder
